guide.text: Talk to the NPC named Lucian outside the entrance of the Mudskipper mine (near the Voidzone entrance). They will ask you to kill 5 Mineskippers. Do so and return.

quests.rewards: Family Recipe, Bravery, 3 Full Training points
quests.name: Mineskipper Mayhem

guide.text: Talk to Beiruul at Meteor Isle, then go to Fort Merit. Event occurs near the lift. Kill some Authority Peacekeepers (~4-6) , then return to Meteor Isle.

quests.rewards: EXP, Bravery, 2 Knowledge, Beiruul's Vengeance, 5 Full Training points
quests.name: Navae's Retribution

quests.location_text: Isle of Vigils, Burning Stone Gardens

guide.text: Talk to Apprentice Kj in The Temple of the Blades, located at the left corridor room; sitting down sobbing.
He asks you to rescue, or find his sibling in Erisia.
His sibling is found in an Abandoned Wood Lodge in Burning Stone Gardens, near a cliff.
Obtain a Gale Stone and give it to the sibling. He'll heal his wounds and ask you to head back to Isle of Vigils and talk to Kj about his status.
Talking to Apprentice Kj after giving the Gale Stone finishes the quest.
Vigil Isaac can be found next to the Mantra Modification table at Vigils after completing the quest.

quests.rewards: EXP, Compassion, Kj's Courage, unlocks dialogue with Evengarde Rest, 5 Full Training points
quests.name: Vigil's Savior

guide.text: Talk to Suri at Greathive Aratel. He will ask you to place a flower on his brother's grave at Isle of Vigils. Taking 3%+ damage while the flower is in your inventory will turn it into a Ruined Flower, forcing you to return to Suri for a new flower.

quests.rewards: Vibrant Gem, Hive Reputation, Compassion, 5 Full Training points, Careful Handling
quests.name: Grave Tending

guide.text: Talk to Nanji at Etris near the bridge between Lance Leshi's and the barber, interact with a sword on the ground near the end of the zipline going away from the Fang and Coil trainer in Isle of Vigils, then talk to the Nanji again.

quests.rewards: EXP, Compassion, Nanji's Training, 5 Full Training points
quests.name: Travelling Blade

guide.text: Talk to Suyuan in the library of the Isle of Vigils. Visit the Beloved Zofia, talk to the ghost on the ship and return to Suyuan.

quests.rewards: EXP, Curiosity, Supernatural Sense, 5 Full Training points
quests.name: Ghost Hunting

guide.text: Follow Karliah to Lower Erisia and save her from a Mudskipper. Choose the "I don't think you're cut out for this. Mudskippers are small fry, you'll face much worse as a Diver. You need to rethink your life goals. [Charisma]" Dialogue option while having at 75 Charisma or else the quest will fail. Return to Karliah at Etris to receive your quest rewards.

npcs: Erosius Amaltus Urivortus Alistus Casius Walistoshus

guide.text: Pull out the spear from the Firfire Caverns and talk to Erosius Amaltus Urivortus Alistus Casius Walistoshus in Firfire to finish the quest.

links: Erosius Amaltus Urivortus Alistus Casius Walistoshus
quests.name: Ethiron's Gaze

guide.text: Turn in 5 Pure Ore (must be Erisore, Irithine, Umbrite or Astruline) to any Blacksmith.

quests.rewards: Excavator, 5 Full Training points on first completion
quests.name: Excavator

guide.text: Talk to a seemingly insane Capra in rags named Kasen in layer 2.
You must have 80 Willpower and have gotten at least stage one of insanity on the slot you attempt to obtain Heretic's Sutra on before claiming this.

Talk to the Gremor NPC Trig outside the Guildhall at Summer Isle. He'll have you find Asius, a merchant who hasn't been paying his dues. When speaking to Asius, the quest has two branching paths from here; each ending is mutually exclusive with the other, locking out the other quest ending. Get the ship deed from Asius then return to Trig at the inn for the Armor Piercing ending. Tell Trig you'll help them for the Bulletproof ending.

quests.afterwards: After completing the Bulletproof ending, you can apologize to Trig, and for 2,000, he will reward you with positive Summer Company reputation, and the Armor Piercing Talent will be added to your Talent pool. There is no way to obtain Bulletproof if you completed the Armor Piercing ending, however.
quests.rewards: Armor Piercing OR Bulletproof Talents (Added to Talent pool, not given instantly), either Positive or Negative Summer Company Reputation depending on the ending (Armor Piercing gives positive rep / Bulletproof gives negative), 3 Full Training points
quests.name: Owed Debts

guide.text: Defeat any boss without taking any damage
Punch down a tree with Strong Left then speak to Korin or Drefa. Punch down 5 more trees and then return to the quest giver.
Talk to Stratos at The Temple of Blade. You must have 50 Galebreathe and at least "Ally" reputation with Etrea. After talking to him you will receive the talent.

quests.afterwards: This quest is notoriously buggy, and the exact requirements for the Windwaker obtainment are still questionable. Take on this quest with patience.
quests.name: Windwaker

quests.location_text: The Garden Reservoir, Burning Stone Gardens

guide.text: Talk to the Etrean NPC Arthur outside of the entrance of The Garden Reservoir. He will ask you to avenge his friends by killing a Megalodaunt. Kill one and return.

quests.name: Megalodaunt Slayer

guide.text: Talk to the Ganymede NPC Jessamine in Starswept Valley. He will ask you to kill a King Thresher. They can be found in the Lightkeeper Temple nearby as a guaranteed spawn. Kill one and return.
Talk to Atra, who will ask you to find a scout named Lars. Lars is found in the bluecap library accessed by unlocking the entrance with the Birdcage or through an entrance in The Viper's Jaw.

Confront Kayla, who can be found hurled up against the wall. They will explain how they lost their favorite Shrouded Cape while running away from a Terrapod. Return with a Shrouded Cape to make their day and earn some rewards.

quests.rewards: EXP, Compassion, +20 rank points (if a Justicar)
quests.name: Terrapod Terror

guide.text: Talk to Sarbu, who will ask for some assistance in learning an ability used only by those within the Vanguard division of the Justicars.

Talk to Elykris in Minityrsa, he will ask you to find a book in Outpust Antumbra. Return to him after finding it. The quest can also be completed in reverse order by obtaining the book and then speaking to Elykris.

quests.rewards: 2 Aces, EXP, Curiosity  (Note: you can actually softlock this quest by donating this book to librarian in guild base)
quests.name: Field Report

guide.text: Bring him 2 Dying Embers
This quest is only available if a character is created with the Castaway Origin. To complete this quest, simply craft the Traveller's Jacket from any Blacksmith.

quests.location_text: Etris, Etris Palace, Duke Erisia's Manor, Duke Erisia's Laboratory

guide.text: Speak to Kennith while having "Ally" or higher Etrea reputation, then speak to Bookkeeper Andros, choosing the first dialogue line. Speak to Andros again, going down the first dialogue line a second time.

From here, head to the Navaen Nomad camp at the Etrean Wilds, there will be trails in the dirt on the outskirts, leading to where Kennith's body will be found. Speak to the Royal Etrean Guard and make your way to the Etris Palace. You may need ally Etrea reputation to get in without the guards attacking you.
If you have completed this quest before, you can skip this step, instead speaking to any of the Royal Etrean Guards at the Palace.

Speak to The Lord Regent and accept his quest, tasking you with taking on Duke Ishamon Erisia. After this, you'll need to make your way over to Duke Erisia's Manor, encounter, and defeat the Duke. Do not return to Regent after completing this quest unless you have neutral or higher Ministry reputation; Regent WILL kill you.

quests.rewards: Manor Key, a key that allows you to access the Duke Ishamon Erisia boss fight
quests.name: Duke of Sin

guide.text: Talk to the Lance's Brother on Isle of Vigils, choosing the second dialogue option will spawn a red box with the text 'Food' on it. To finish the quest, give the box to Stratos, located in the courtyard of the Temple of the Blade.

quests.rewards: 25 Notes and positive reputation with Etrea
quests.name: Temple Delivery

quests.location_text: Isle of Vigils and Etrean Wilds

guide.text: Talk to Kelsius at librarian in the Isle of Vigils library. He will ask you to pick up some books. Go to the hut under Etrean Wild, talk to the NPCs there and come back to the librarian.
If the quest has been completed before, the books can instead be found on a rock behind the Vigil's bank.

quests.rewards: Whisper Draw OR 1 Knowledge, 3 Full Training points  Note: If you have already escaped The Depths, have done the Tutorial or have beaten any World Boss, you will not gain the Whisper Draw and will instead gain 1 Knowledge.
quests.name: Lost Books

guide.text: Talk to Ploom inside of Lance Leshis food shop.
Talk to Polis standing under the tree in Etris.

quests.rewards: Gold Ring or Jus Karita if you meet the requirements
quests.name: Polis' Stories

guide.text: Talk to Regek at Greathive Aratel's archives. He will ask you to find every Soulbloom. They can be found in the Greathive.

quests.rewards: Attunement-less Mantra trainer (Regek), 3 Full Training points
quests.name: Soulblooms

guide.text: Adjust a telescope to look at the stars, tells you some information about Celestial.
Talk to The Guy near Meteor Isle. With high enough Charisma, you may finish the quest immediately and obtain his glasses. Otherwise, you have to bring him 3 spider eggs.

quests.rewards: Be able to use the Summer Isle cannon to get to Songseeker Wilds, The Guy's Eyeglasses (Charisma only), 3 Full Training points
quests.name: The Guy

quests.location_text: Isle of Vigils(Temple of the Blade)

guide.text: Give an NPC in Temple of Blade a Weapon Manual to help him defeat 'the guy on the other side'. (You can buy another one at a gear cabinet)

quests.name: Fraud Maestro

quests.location_text: Isle of Vigils, Etrean Wilds, Lower Erisia, The Monkey's Paw

guide.text: Talk to Zana on the Isle of Vigils docks with a Katana, Alloyed Katana, or Shattered Katana equipped. Fight him and win at various locations.

quests.name: Poser's Ring

guide.text: Kill Songseekers at Derelict Highchurch. This quest was formerly known as "Ku's Shrine".
Talk to the Forgotten Villagers in the Church of Erisor. Help them through the waves of monsters and bandit leaders.
Save a hostage from Fort Merit and give them to the Etrean Guardmaster outside of the fort on a dinghy.
Kill Golden Rats inside the Rat's Den to get Gold Plates. Turn them into the Golden Rat Guard standing outside for a chest.
Talk to a Ministry NPC found in various places around the map, they will ask you to kill anyone at a certain location.
Turn in Navaean hostages to Alastir.
Turn in the bags found around Starswept Valley to Mercille near the Guy at the outpost near Meteor Isle.
Give the Explosive boxes that can be found all around Summer Isle to Scope at the storage room in Summer Isle.

quests.rewards: Chest, Reputation, 3 Full Training points on first completion
quests.name: Summer Isle Explosive Boxes
